paper_metadata.title: A 1.8-V 128-Mb Mobile DRAM With Double Boosting Pump, Hybrid Current Sense Amplifier, and Dual-Referenced Adjustment Scheme for Temperature Sensor
paper_metadata.abstract: To verify three important circuit schemes suitable for DRAMs in mobile applications, a 1.8-V 128-Mb SDRAM was implemented with a 0.15m technology. To achieve an ideal 33% efficiency, the double boosting pump uses two capacitor’s series connection at pumping phase, while they are precharged in parallel. The hybrid folded current sense amplifier together with a novel replica inverter connection improved power and speed performances. Also, a dual-referenced adjustment scheme for a temperature sensor was proposed to allow a very high accuracy in tuning. Without loss in productivity, the implemented dual-referenced searching technique achieved tuning error of less than 2.5 C.
